chk_media_minor_consent.name: chk_media_minor_consent
chk_media_minor_consent.value: "media_assets"."has_identifiable_minors" = false or ("media_assets"."consent" = 'obtained' and "media_assets"."consent_reference" is not null)

projects_date_order.name: projects_date_order
projects_date_order.value: "projects"."end_date" is null or "projects"."start_date" is null or "projects"."end_date" >= "projects"."start_date"

submissions_payload_exclusive.name: submissions_payload_exclusive
submissions_payload_exclusive.value: ("form_submissions"."is_sensitive" and "form_submissions"."payload" is null and "form_submissions"."payload_encrypted" is not null and "form_submissions"."payload_key_id" is not null) or (not "form_submissions"."is_sensitive" and "form_submissions"."payload" is not null and "form_submissions"."payload_encrypted" is null and "form_submissions"."payload_key_id" is null)

submissions_sensitive_unlinkable.name: submissions_sensitive_unlinkable
submissions_sensitive_unlinkable.value: not "form_submissions"."is_sensitive" or ("form_submissions"."ip_hash" is null and "form_submissions"."user_agent" is null)
